editorial: In today's technology agenda, infrastructure tools based on codebase memory management and decentralized network protocols stand out. Time series forecasting models published by Google Research promise a significant increase in efficiency in data analytics.

items.title: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
items.summary: Codebase-memory-mcp offers high-performance code intelligence by transforming code bases into a permanent knowledge graph. Developed in C language, the tool supports 158 programming languages, reduces query times to below milliseconds and reduces token usage.

items.title: n0-computer/iroh
items.summary: Iroh is a modular networking stack that uses a key-based structure in network connections, eliminating dependency on IP addresses. Developed in the Rust language, this tool aims to make network communication in distributed systems more flexible and durable.

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.summary: Agent-Reach is a command line interface (CLI) tool that gives AI agents the ability to crawl social media and content platforms on the internet. It allows users to read and search data from platforms such as Twitter, Reddit and GitHub without paying any application programming interface (API) fees.

items.title: meshery/meshery
items.summary: Meshery is a service mesh management platform developed to manage the lifecycle of cloud native infrastructures. It provides a central control plane over the configuration, performance and security of distributed systems.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.summary: Superpowers offers a framework and methodology used to create agent-based skills in software development processes. This tool aims to standardize software development workflows with an agent-oriented approach.

items.title: google-research/timesfm
items.summary: The Time Series Foundation Model, developed by Google Research, offers a pre-trained structure for time series forecasting. The model is designed to provide general predictive capabilities on different data sets.

items.title: RocketChat/Rocket.Chat
items.summary: Rocket.Chat offers a secure communications operating system designed for mission-critical operations. The platform, developed with the TypeScript language, aims to centralize internal messaging and collaboration processes.

items.title: continuedev/continue
items.summary: Continue is an open source coding agent designed to automate software development processes. It allows developers to write, debug and refactor code within the IDE using their native language models (LLM).

items.title: penpot/penpot
items.summary: Penpot is an open source design tool that strengthens collaboration between designers and developers. Thanks to its vector-based interface, it allows you to manage design processes in an integrated manner with the coding phase.

items.title: krahets/hello-algo
items.summary: Hello 算法 is an open source educational platform that supports data structures and algorithms with animated visualizations. Offering support for many programming languages, the project aims to make complex concepts understandable with code examples and interactive content.

items.title: Universal-Debloater-Alliance/universal-android-debloater-next-generation
items.summary: Universal Android Debloater Next Generation is a cross-platform interface developed in Rust language and uses the ADB (Android Debug Bridge) protocol to remove unnecessary software (bloatware) on Android devices. This application, which does not require root access (root), aims to improve device privacy, security and battery life.

items.title: mattpocock/skills
items.summary: This repository, shared by Matt Pocock, contains scripts and structured instructions for software engineers to use artificial intelligence assistants more efficiently. Developers use these ready-made skill sets to improve the performance of artificial intelligence models such as Claude in coding and debugging processes.

items.title: yairm210/Unciv
items.summary: Unciv is an open source desktop and Android adaptation of the Civilization V game. Developed in Kotlin language, the project brings original game mechanics to users on a lighter infrastructure.

items.title: freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp
items.summary: freeCodeCamp is an open source platform that offers free educational materials on mathematics, programming and computer science. Developed with the TypeScript language, the project allows users to improve their software development skills through an applied curriculum.

items.title: bytedance/UI-TARS-desktop
items.summary: Developed by ByteDance, UI-TARS is an open source agent infrastructure that integrates multimodal AI models with desktop interfaces. This system enables the creation of agents (AI agents) that autonomously perform tasks on the computer by processing visual data.

items.title: nautechsystems/nautilus_trader
items.summary: Nautilus Trader is a trading engine with a deterministic event-driven architecture, developed in Rust language. It offers production-grade infrastructure solutions for high-performance financial systems.

items.title: chatwoot/chatwoot
items.summary: Chatwoot provides live chat, e-mail support and omni-channel support management with its open source structure. Offering an alternative to platforms such as Intercom and Zendesk, this tool centralizes customer interactions through a single panel.

items.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
items.summary: OpenMontage is an open source agent-based system that turns AI coding assistants into a full-fledged video production studio. This Python-based platform automates video production processes with 12 different pipelines and more than 500 agent skills.

items.title: alexzhang13/rlm
items.summary: Developed for Recursive Language Models, rlm is a plug-and-play inference library that supports different sandboxes. This Python-based tool standardizes complex language model processes, making them easier to integrate into different systems.

items.title: makeplane/plane
items.summary: Plane is an open source project management platform that brings together task management, sprint planning and documentation processes. Developed as an alternative to enterprise tools such as Jira and Linear, this platform allows teams to organize workflows through a central interface.

items.title: Lore – Open source version control system designed for scalability
items.summary: Lore was developed as an open source version control system designed with a focus on scalability. It offers an alternative infrastructure for managing large data sets and complex workflows in software projects.

items.title: Volkswagen started blocking GrapheneOS users
items.summary: Volkswagen prevents its mobile application from running on devices with GrapheneOS operating system for security reasons. The company restricts access to the application in accordance with security protocols when root access or customized software is detected.

items.title: Midjourney Medical
items.summary: Midjourney is developing a specialized artificial intelligence model (medical AI model) to analyze medical imaging data and make sense of radiological scans. With this system, the company aims to accelerate diagnostic processes and create a standard infrastructure for processing medical visual data.

items.title: US holds off blacklisting DeepSeek, more than 100 firms deemed security risks
items.summary: The United States has postponed restrictions on the DeepSeek platform for now, despite blacklisting more than a hundred Chinese companies due to security risks. The decision in question shows that investigations into the effects of technology companies on national security continue.

items.title: RFC 10008: The new HTTP Query Method
items.summary: The HTTP Query Method introduces a new standard that can carry body content but is designed for secure and side-effectless operations. This method allows more complex data queries to be passed by bypassing the URL length restrictions of the current GET request.

items.title: yuxinlu1/gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5-v1-GGUF
items.summary: The Gemma-4-12B-coder model is a text-generation model optimized for coding tasks. Thanks to the GGUF format, it offers local inference on devices with limited hardware resources.

items.title: zai-org/GLM-5.2
items.summary: GLM-5.2, developed by Zai-org, is a language model designed for text generation tasks. This model, published on the HuggingFace platform, offers content creation capabilities in natural language processing processes.

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3
items.summary: MiniMax-M3 stands out as a multimodal model that can process text and visual data simultaneously. The system offers the ability to produce meaningful text outputs by analyzing visual and textual inputs.

items.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K2.7-Code
items.summary: Developed by Moonshot AI, Kimi-K2.7-Code is a multimodal coding model that can process visual and text data as input. It is designed to produce text-based code outputs by analyzing visual content during software development processes.

items.title: google/diffusiongemma-26B-A4B-it
items.summary: Google introduced the DiffusionGemma-26B-A4B-it model, a multimodal artificial intelligence model that produces text-based outputs by processing text and image inputs. This model aims to increase analysis ability in complex tasks by processing visual and textual data in an integrated structure.
